The Ultimate FEC Owner's Guide: How Digital Sports Simulators Drive Foot Traffic and Revenue

Running a Family Entertainment Center (FEC) has never been easy.

Revenue is tighter. Families are more deliberate about how they spend. And a growing number of entertainment options are competing for the same guests. What you need is an attraction that makes people want to pay, post, and come back with friends.

That's exactly what digital sports simulators deliver.

Here's a practical guide for FEC operators—from choosing the right equipment to building a profitable, sustainable venue.

Challenge #1: Guests Don't Stay Long Enough

Solution: Use immersive, social equipment to extend dwell time

Guests who come and go quickly mean missed opportunities for F&B sales, repeat visits, and word-of-mouth. Digital sports equipment keeps people engaged because it turns exercise into an addictive game.

  • Digital Tennis Simulator (LJST003) – Uses recognition systems and HD 3D visuals to deliver realistic singles or doubles play. One round is never enough—guests stay for three, four, or more.

  • Interactive Soccer (LJST022) – Cameras and infrared sensors track player kicks, projecting realistic 3D goal-scoring scenarios. It combines fitness, competition, and fun in one package.

  • Red & Blue Ball Duel (LJST030) – A team-versus-team interactive game that builds cooperation and quick reactions. Perfect for family showdowns and group competitions that keep guests engaged for hours.

Challenge #2: Your Offerings Look Like Everyone Else's

Solution: Differentiate with unique, tech-driven experiences

If your FEC looks like every other FEC, why would guests choose you? Digital sports simulators offer the "wow factor" and exclusivity that set you apart.

  • Digital Skiing Simulator (LJST009) – Developed using German professional ski simulator principles, with AI algorithms and induction motor drive systems. Guests in warm climates have never seen anything like it—and that's your selling point.

  • Interactive Surfing (LJST047) – Body-weight controlled surfing with immersive visuals. No ocean, no summer required—guests can "surf" year-round at your venue.

  • Horse Riding Archery (LJST001) – Combines horseback riding and archery for a full-body workout. It's so unique that guests can't resist taking photos and sharing.

Challenge #3: Equipment Maintenance Is Eating Your Profits

Solution: Choose commercial-grade, low-maintenance simulators

FEC equipment gets used hundreds of times a day. It needs to be tough. Digital sports simulators are built with industrial-grade components and cost far less to maintain than traditional mechanical attractions.

  • 3D Billiards (LJST050) – Fancy version: 1.85m × 1m × 0.9m; Standard version: 1.68m × 0.78m × 0.67m. Power: just 300W. Compact, low-energy, nearly zero maintenance—yet delivers 4K HD pool experiences.

  • Multiplayer Basketball (LJST026) – Breaks the traditional solo shooting model with multiplayer competitive play and HD 3D visuals. Simple structure, high durability—a must-have for any FEC.

  • Olympic Shooting (LJST008) – A 1:1 recreation of Olympic shooting principles with exceptional precision. Stable, easy to maintain, and gives guests an instant sense of achievement.

Challenge #4: Not Sure What to Buy? Afraid of Making the Wrong Investment?

Solution: Build a balanced equipment mix—Traffic + Retention + Revenue

A healthy FEC equipment portfolio is like a sports team: you need forwards (traffic drivers), midfielders (retention), and defenders (revenue generators).
